title: Chicago
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Biohazard symbol. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Blue Chicago Infection card. The city name runs down the left edge over a blue North America map with a green infection mark. No rules text. The scan is numbered P1-06b.

rules: Blue Infection card for Chicago. Two copies share this face.
P1-01b puts both copies in the Game End area when the package is opened.
notes: Card id 904. Count 2. The shared scan is printed P1-06b.
The 20-card package numbering has no other image for P1-05b. That is the likely code of the second physical copy, and it is not printed on this scan.
